mapper.select: WITH record_ranked AS ( SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY wk_id ORDER BY create_ymd) AS rn_start, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY wk_id ORDER BY create_ymd DESC) AS rn_end FROM pet_walk_record ), s_day AS ( SELECT wk_id, longitude, latitude, create_ymd FROM record_ranked WHERE rn_start = 1 ), e_day AS ( SELECT wk_id, longitude, latitude, create_ymd FROM record_ranked WHERE rn_end = 1 ), user_profile_file AS ( SELECT wr_id, bf_fileurl FROM g5_board_file WHERE bo_table = 'user_profile' ), ReplyData AS ( SELECT pwr.wk_id, JSON_ARRAYAGG( JSON_OBJECT( 'wkReplyId', pwr.wk_reply_id, 'mbId', pwr.mb_id, 'contents', pwr.contents, 'subReplyList', COALESCE(sub.sub_reply_list, JSON_ARRAY()), 'createYmd', DATE_FORMAT(pwr.create_ymd, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'), 'createId', pwr.create_id, 'mbNick', gm.mb_nick, 'userProfileUrl', upf.bf_fileurl ) ) AS reply_list FROM pet_walk_reply pwr JOIN g5_member gm ON pwr.mb_id = gm.mb_id LEFT JOIN user_profile_file upf ON gm.mb_no = upf.wr_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT pwsr.wk_reply_id, JSON_ARRAYAGG( JSON_OBJECT( 'wkSuplyId', pwsr.wk_suply_id, 'mbId', pwsr.mb_id, 'contents', pwsr.contents, 'createYmd', DATE_FORMAT(pwsr.create_ymd, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'), 'createId', pwsr.create_id, 'mbNick', gm.mb_nick, 'userProfileUrl', upf.bf_fileurl ) ) AS sub_reply_list FROM pet_walk_sub_reply pwsr JOIN g5_member gm ON pwsr.mb_id = gm.mb_id LEFT JOIN user_profile_file upf ON gm.mb_no = upf.wr_id WHERE pwsr.del_fl = 0 GROUP BY pwsr.wk_reply_id ) sub ON pwr.wk_reply_id = sub.wk_reply_id WHERE pwr.del_fl = 0 GROUP BY pwr.wk_id ), imageData AS ( SELECT pwfm.wk_id, JSON_ARRAYAGG( JSON_OBJECT( 'wkFmapId', pwfm.wk_fmap_id, 'imageUrl', bf.bf_fileurl, 'fileName', bf.bf_source ) ) AS image_list FROM pet_walk_file_mapping pwfm LEFT JOIN g5_board_file bf ON pwfm.wk_fmap_id = bf.wr_id AND bf.bo_table = 'pet_walk' GROUP BY pwfm.wk_id ), likeUserData AS ( SELECT pwlm.wk_id, JSON_ARRAYAGG( JSON_OBJECT('mbId', pwlm.mb_id) ) AS like_user_list FROM pet_walk_like_mapping pwlm WHERE pwlm.del_fl = 0 GROUP BY pwlm.wk_id ) SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY pw.create_ymd DESC) AS row_num, pw.wk_id, pw.mb_id, pw.contents, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pet_walk_like_mapping WHERE wk_id = pw.wk_id AND mb_id = #{mbId} AND del_fl = 0 ) AS is_liked, lud.like_user_list, pw.create_ymd, pw.create_id, rd.reply_list, id.image_list, gm.mb_nick, upf.bf_fileurl AS user_profile_url, DATE_FORMAT(pw.create_ymd, '%Y-%m-%d') AS walk_date, s_day.create_ymd AS start_date, e_day.create_ymd AS end_date, pw.wk_distance AS distance_km, pw.water_ml, pw.dung, (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG( JSON_OBJECT( 'petId', pi.pet_id, 'petNm', pi.pet_nm, 'isDefault', pi.is_default, 'petFileUrl', bf.bf_fileurl ) ) FROM pet_info pi INNER JOIN g5_board_file bf ON pi.pet_id = bf.wr_id AND bf.bo_table = 'pet_info' WHERE FIND_IN_SET(pi.pet_id, pw.pet_ids)) AS pet_list, pw.wk_time, pw.wk_distance, (SELECT COUNT(wklm_id) FROM pet_walk_like_mapping WHERE wk_id = pw.wk_id AND del_fl = 0) AS like_cnt, pw.boast_fl FROM pet_walk pw JOIN g5_member gm ON pw.mb_id = gm.mb_id LEFT JOIN user_profile_file upf ON gm.mb_no = upf.wr_id LEFT JOIN s_day ON pw.wk_id = s_day.wk_id LEFT JOIN e_day ON pw.wk_id = e_day.wk_id LEFT JOIN ReplyData rd ON pw.wk_id = rd.wk_id LEFT JOIN imageData id ON pw.wk_id = id.wk_id LEFT JOIN likeUserData lud ON pw.wk_id = lud.wk_id WHERE pw.del_fl = 0 AND pw.wk_id = #{wkId};

SELECT ranking_no, mb_id, mb_nick, bf_fileurl, wk_distance, wk_time FROM pet_walk_ranking WHERE del_fl = 0 ORDER BY ranking_no LIMIT 0, 30;

SELECT gm.mb_id, gm.mb_nick, MAX(pw.start_date) AS start_date, pw.wk_distance, pw.wk_time, gbf.bf_fileurl, ranking.ranking_no FROM g5_member gm LEFT JOIN pet_walk pw ON pw.mb_id = gm.mb_id LEFT JOIN g5_board_file gbf ON gbf.bo_table = 'user_profile' AND gm.mb_no = gbf.wr_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT mb_id, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY wk_time DESC) AS ranking_no FROM pet_walk GROUP BY mb_id ) ranking ON pw.mb_id = ranking.mb_id WHERE gm.mb_id = #{mbId} GROUP BY mb_id
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN po_point > 0 THEN po_point ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_point FROM g5_point WHERE mb_id = #{mbId} AND po_rel_table = '@walk_point';
